payload.name: Verify Redundancy Before Skipping Candidate
payload.description: Use during CRUD/decision when a candidate is about to be SKIPped as already covered or updated; verify the referenced memory actually exists before skipping.
content: During CRUD/decision stage, before marking any candidate as SKIP for redundancy, verify that a memory containing the same facts actually exists in the retrieved existing-memory pool or was accepted earlier in the current batch.
If the skip reason references an 'updated memory' that cannot be found in the pool or in accepted updates, do not skip; instead ADD or UPDATE to persist the candidate.
Only skip when the identical information is verifiably present in the relevant memory records; when in doubt, keep the candidate to avoid information loss.

solves: Prevents loss of extracted facts when the Construction Agent skips a candidate believing the information already exists in an updated memory, but no such memory is actually present in the current pool or batch. Instills a verification step before SKIP decisions to ensure redundancy claims are grounded in real memory records.
